name: i2c-two-devices
prompt: Build a circuit with an Arduino Uno reading an IMU sensor and showing values on an OLED display, both on the same I2C bus, with 4.7k pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL.
notes: Differs from i2c-sensor by demanding a shared bus and explicit pull-ups. The assertion that both devices sit on the same SDA/SCL nets is the point of the case.
